overall: 3 things worth a look here: colors don't echo, fabrics from different weather and nothing leads.
works: The tan cords and the boots hold the bottom half completely steady, which is what lets the top half be as loud as it is.

issues.label: Colors don't echo
issues.summary: The blue beanie, green tank, pink belt, teal bag and orange socks each bring a color that turns up nowhere else.

remedy.guidance: Repeating one of these colors somewhere else — a second piece in the same family — would tie them together.

issues.label: Fabrics from different weather
issues.summary: The mesh tank is a hot-weather fabric against corduroy shorts and suede boots.

remedy.reason: Made of something that belongs to the same weather as the rest.

issues.label: Nothing leads
issues.summary: The printed camp shirt, the green mesh tank and the sling bag are all pitched at the same volume, so nothing gets to lead.

remedy.guidance: Decide which piece is the one you want noticed first, and let everything else sit behind it.
